key_facts: The project aims to create a remote control that can generate a profit of fifty million Euros.
The remote control is expected to be sold for twenty five Euros, which is about fifteen Pounds.
The remote control needs to be trendy to achieve the desired profit.
The team is considering the design of the remote control, including color and size.
The remote control should have unique features to differentiate it from existing products.
The Marketing team suggests evaluating market potential, competition, and design before finalizing the project.
The team plans to allocate tasks, with the User Interface and Industrial Designer researching other remote controls and their designs.
The remote control should be attractive and have a good look to appeal to users.
The team is considering a design similar to a P_D_A_ but not focusing on the screen.
The team will have another meeting in half an hour to discuss further details.
